meta.name: qdrant-sizing
meta.description: Sizes a Qdrant deployment before it is provisioned. Use when someone asks 'how much RAM do I need', 'how many nodes', 'how big should my cluster be', 'sizing', 'capacity planning', 'will N vectors fit', 'what instance type should I pick', or gives a vector count and dimensions and asks what to provision. Also use when an existing estimate needs checking before hardware or a cluster tier is bought.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 估算 Qdrant 部署所需内存与节点数
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在规划 Qdrant 集群规模,需要预估内存与节点数。
copy.tagline_en: Estimate the memory and nodes needed for a Qdrant deployment.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're planning a Qdrant cluster and need to estimate memory and node count.

howto.what: Claude会根据你给出的向量数、维度等，估算Qdrant集群需要的内存、磁盘、CPU、GPU和节点数，并给出量化、内存分层等配置建议。
howto.when: 当用户询问需要多少内存、节点或磁盘，或给出向量数与维度要求配置时触发；也可用于购买前复核已有估算。

say.text: 我有100万条128维向量，需要多少内存和磁盘？
3节点集群，复制因子2，需要留多少余量？
我的向量适合量化吗？存储空间怎么变？
say.note: 量化与原始向量并存，需按公式重算

howto.what_en: Claude sizes a Qdrant deployment before it is provisioned. Based on given vector counts, dimensions, payload, throughput, etc., it estimates required RAM, disk, CPU, GPU, and node count, and advises on memory tiers, quantization, and headroom for growth.
howto.when_en: Activates when the user asks about memory, node, or disk requirements, or provides vector count and dimensions asking what to provision. Also used to check an existing estimate before buying hardware or a cluster tier.

say_en.text: I have 1 million 128-dim vectors, how much RAM and disk do I need?
For a 3-node cluster with replication factor 2, what headroom should I keep?
Is quantization suitable for my vectors and what space will it take?
